_note: Every gameplay number that may change, read and checked by crates/core/src/tuning.rs when the page starts. Units are in each key's name: _ms milliseconds, _mm millimetres, _mm_per_s millimetres a second, _deg degrees, _deg_per_s degrees a second, _pct percent. A missing, unknown or out-of-range key is refused by name. Other systems (fishing, items, radar, fish) add their own section here and its struct in tuning.rs.

match._note: length_ms: 8 minutes (BRIEF), the default the match setup offers among length_choices_ms. buoy_interval_ms: an item buoy every minute (BRIEF), the default among buoy_interval_choices_ms; the items system reads the match's own value (Match::setup). seats: lobby slots, coloured blue, red, green, yellow. spawn_spread_mm: the gap between neighbouring boats at the spawn, side by side across the heading.

boat._note: top_speed 16 m/s is the speed the map size was chosen for (map/mod.rs BOAT_TOP_SPEED_MM_PER_S). accel_ms: W from rest to top speed (BRIEF: about 5 s). With no throttle the boat slows from top speed to rest in coast_ms; S while moving forward brakes from top to rest in brake_ms; sideways slip dies from top speed in side_drag_ms. Turning: turn_deg_per_s once the boat moves at turn_full_at_pct of top speed or faster, turn_at_rest_pct of it at rest, and in between in proportion. In fishing mode A and D swivel the cast at swivel_deg_per_s, up to swivel_limit_deg either side of the bow. The hull for collisions: a rounded box half_length_mm plus half_beam_mm from the middle to the bow, half_beam_mm to each side. nitrous: the items system turns it on; each figure is a percent of the plain one.

wreck._note: A boat wrecks another when its speed toward it is ram_wreck_pct of top speed or more (BRIEF: 80%, judged without nitrous), and its own motor stalls for stall_ms (round 1, B1). A boat wrecks on land when its speed toward the land is land_wreck_pct of top speed or more (BRIEF: 50%); slower, it bounces back at bounce_pct of that speed and keeps scrape_keep_pct of its speed along the shore. Slower boat hits bump both boats apart at bump_pct. A wrecked boat comes back at the spawn after respawn_ms (BRIEF: 2 s), ghosted for ghost_ms (round 1, B3): it passes through boats and cannot wreck or be wrecked by one.
